items.stem: Which is the best everyday example of AI at work?

options.A: A wall clock that ticks each second
options.B: A music app suggesting songs like ones you played
options.C: A paper calendar pinned to a fridge

items.stem: Why do many AI tools feel "invisible" in daily life?

options.A: They often run in the background to sort or suggest
options.B: They only work when you open a chat window
options.C: They replace every button on your phone

items.stem: A maps app reroutes you around heavy traffic. What is it mainly using?

options.A: A single fixed path printed at the factory
options.C: Patterns from recent road and trip data

items.stem: Which task is least like modern everyday AI?

options.B: Adding two numbers with a basic calculator

items.stem: "People also bought" on a shop site is usually:

options.A: A suggestion based on patterns in past purchases
options.B: A random list with no link to anyone's history
options.C: A human clerk typing live for every visitor

items.stem: Voice assistants that turn speech into actions are useful because they:

options.C: Match spoken words to likely commands from practice on many examples

items.stem: Seeing AI in daily life should make you:

options.A: Hand every decision to the app with no check
options.B: Notice suggestions, then judge if they fit your goal
options.C: Assume only engineers ever meet AI

items.stem: Which pair are both common daily AI touches?

options.A: Spam filters and photo face groups

items.stem: A feed that keeps showing similar videos is best described as:

options.C: Ranking content from patterns in what people watch
